def: How long a fact or skill stays true: model rankings and tool versions expire in months, while methods and habits last years.
A short running record of what you read, with the claim, the evidence and whether you would test it, used to judge which sources are worth keeping.
A fixed, regular amount of time for following the field, chosen in advance so that keeping up does not crowd out building.
The original paper, specification, changelog or data behind a claim, as opposed to a summary or commentary on it.
Using your own saved evaluation set to measure what a new model or tool changes for your tasks, instead of trusting public rankings.
